items.story:
Greylock, a prominent venture capital firm, has capped its new fund at $1.5 billion, despite indications that it could have raised more capital from investors. This decision reflects the firm's strategic approach to maintaining a focused investment portfolio, allowing it to provide dedicated support to its portfolio companies. By limiting the size of its fund, Greylock aims to prioritize quality over quantity, ensuring that it can deliver substantial value to its partners. This move underscores the firm's commitment to building strong relationships with founders and helping them navigate the complexities of growing a successful business.

The firm has backed notable startups, including Airbnb, LinkedIn, and Dropbox, among others. Its investment strategy is centered around providing guidance, resources, and network access to entrepreneurs, enabling them to scale their businesses effectively. By keeping the number of investments to about 25 per fund, Greylock aims to remain closely involved with each portfolio company, offering tailored support and expertise to help them overcome challenges and achieve their goals.

items.story:
Researchers at New York University have made a significant breakthrough in solving the perplexing "reverse sprinkler" problem, a physics puzzle that had stumped renowned physicist Richard Feynman. The problem, which involves understanding the motion of a sprinkler when its water supply is reversed, has been a subject of debate among physicists for decades. According to the researchers, their solution not only applies to the reverse sprinkler but also to "silly sprinklers," which are sprinklers with an off-center axis of rotation. The findings have been widely reported and are considered a major advancement in the field of physics. The researchers' work is based on a deep understanding of the physical mechanisms behind the motion of sprinklers.

The reverse sprinkler problem has a long history, dating back to the 1960s when Feynman first proposed it as a challenge to his students. The problem is deceptively simple: when a sprinkler is connected to a water supply, it rotates in a certain direction, but when the water supply is reversed, the sprinkler's rotation is expected to reverse as well. However, this is not always the case, and the problem has been the subject of much debate and research over the years. The problem is important not just because of its inherent interest, but also because it has implications for our understanding of the behavior of complex systems. By solving the reverse sprinkler problem, researchers can gain insights into the behavior of other complex systems, such as those found in engineering and biology.

The researchers' solution to the problem is based on a detailed analysis of the physical mechanisms that govern the motion of sprinklers. According to the researchers, the key to understanding the reverse sprinkler problem lies in the interaction between the sprinkler's rotating parts and the water supply. The researchers used a combination of theoretical models and experimental techniques to study the motion of sprinklers under different conditions. Their findings show that the motion of a sprinkler is determined by a complex interplay of factors, including the sprinkler's design, the water pressure, and the friction between the sprinkler's moving parts. The researchers' work provides a detailed and comprehensive explanation of the reverse sprinkler problem, and their findings have been widely praised by the scientific community.

items.story:
A Tesla driver involved in a fatal crash in Texas last month pressed the accelerator pedal 100% in the moments leading up to the accident, according to a confirmation by the National Transportation Safety Board. The incident occurred when the Tesla vehicle, which was reportedly operating with its advanced driver assistance system engaged, crashed into a tree, resulting in the deaths of two occupants. The NTSB's confirmation supports Tesla's account of the crash, which the company shared publicly days after the incident. This development is significant as it sheds more light on the circumstances surrounding the fatal accident.

The crash has sparked renewed debate about the safety and reliability of advanced driver assistance systems, including Tesla's Autopilot feature. Tesla has consistently maintained that its Autopilot system is designed to assist drivers, but not replace them, and that drivers must remain attentive and engaged at all times when using the feature. The company has also emphasized that the system is not capable of fully autonomous driving and requires constant human oversight. The incident in Texas is one of several recent accidents involving Tesla vehicles operating with Autopilot engaged, raising concerns about the potential risks associated with these systems.

According to the NTSB, data from the Tesla vehicle's onboard computer indicates that the driver pressed the accelerator pedal to 100% in the seconds preceding the crash, despite the presence of a tree in the vehicle's path. The NTSB's findings are based on a preliminary analysis of the data, which also shows that the vehicle's Autopilot system was engaged at the time of the crash. Tesla has stated that the Autopilot system is designed to detect and respond to obstacles, but the company has not commented on why the system failed to prevent the accident in this instance. The NTSB's investigation is ongoing, and the agency is expected to release a more detailed report on the crash in the coming months.

The confirmation of the Tesla driver's actions has been met with concern from safety advocates, who argue that the incident highlights the need for more stringent regulations and oversight of advanced driver assistance systems. The incident has also sparked a reaction from lawmakers, with some calling for greater transparency and accountability from manufacturers of autonomous and semi-autonomous vehicles.

The incident in Texas is part of a broader conversation about the safety and regulation of advanced driver assistance systems, which are becoming increasingly common in modern vehicles. As the technology continues to evolve, there are growing concerns about the potential risks and unintended consequences of these systems, particularly in situations where drivers may become overly reliant on them. As the investigation into the Tesla crash continues, the company is likely to face increased scrutiny over the safety and reliability of its Autopilot system. The current eruption, which began in 2018, has been characterized by periodic episodes of increased activity, including lava fountaining and the emission of volcanic gases. The Halemaumau crater, which is located within Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, has been the focal point of much of the recent activity, with lava flows and gas emissions posing a potential threat to nearby communities. items.story:
A growing outbreak of cyclosporiasis, a diarrheal illness caused by the cyclospora parasite, has been reported across the United States, with thousands of cases identified. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has confirmed up to 7,000 cases of cyclosporiasis, with a significant cluster of cases reported in the Midwest. As the outbreak continues to spread, concerns about food safety have increased, with many people wondering what they can do to protect themselves. The parasite is typically spread through contaminated food and water, highlighting the importance of proper food handling and hygiene practices.

The cyclospora parasite has been a recurring problem in the United States, with periodic outbreaks reported over the years. However, the current outbreak is notable for its size and scope, with cases reported in multiple states. The parasite is usually associated with imported produce, particularly fresh fruits and vegetables, and outbreaks often occur during the summer months when these products are more widely available. The CDC and other health agencies have been working to identify the source of the outbreak, but so far, no single source has been confirmed. This lack of information has made it difficult for consumers to know what foods are safe to eat.

According to the CDC, the majority of cases have been reported in the Midwest, with Illinois, Iowa, and Wisconsin among the states with the highest number of cases. The agency has also reported that many of the cases are associated with eating at restaurants, highlighting the importance of proper food handling practices in the food service industry. Health officials have emphasized the need for consumers to take precautions when eating out, such as avoiding undercooked or raw produce and making sure that food is handled and stored properly. The CDC has also provided guidance on how to safely handle and cook food at home to reduce the risk of infection.

The outbreak has had a significant impact on the food industry, with many restaurants and food establishments taking steps to ensure that their products are safe for consumption. Some companies have issued recalls of potentially contaminated products, while others have increased their sanitation and hygiene protocols to reduce the risk of contamination. Consumers have also been affected, with many people changing their eating habits and avoiding certain types of food that may be contaminated. The economic impact of the outbreak is also a concern, with the potential for significant losses to the food industry and related businesses.

The cyclospora outbreak has also raised concerns about the broader food safety system in the United States. The fact that the outbreak has been able to spread so widely and rapidly has highlighted the need for more effective surveillance and tracking of foodborne illnesses. Health officials and regulators have called for increased funding and support for food safety programs, as well as improved communication and coordination between different agencies and industries. The outbreak has also underscored the importance of international cooperation on food safety issues, as the global food supply chain becomes increasingly complex and interconnected.

As the outbreak continues to unfold, health officials and consumers will be watching closely for any new developments or updates on the source of the contamination. The CDC and other agencies will continue to investigate and monitor the situation, providing guidance and recommendations to consumers and the food industry. In the meantime, consumers can take steps to protect themselves by practicing good hygiene, cooking food thoroughly, and avoiding potentially contaminated products. The situation is likely to continue to evolve in the coming weeks and months, with ongoing efforts to contain and prevent further spread of the outbreak.

items.headline: High-stakes dinosaur auction fuels debate over commercialization's impact on scientific integrity and discovery.
items.teaser: Sotheby's recent auction of a nearly complete Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton has raised concerns among scientists and museum curators that th…
items.story:
Sotheby's recent auction of a nearly complete Tyrannosaurus rex skeleton has raised concerns among scientists and museum curators that the increasing involvement of private buyers in the fossil market is undermining the pursuit of scientific knowledge. The auction, which took place in New York, saw the T. rex skeleton sell for a record-breaking price, highlighting the growing trend of private collectors outbidding museums for valuable fossils. This development has sparked worries that scientifically significant specimens are being lost to private hands, where they may not be accessible for research or public display. As a result, many in the scientific community are calling for greater regulation of the fossil trade to ensure that important specimens are preserved for the benefit of science and society.

The phenomenon of private buyers outbidding museums for fossils is not new, but it has gained momentum in recent years, driven in part by the growing wealth of private collectors and the increasing popularity of fossil collecting as a hobby. Many museums, which have traditionally been the primary repositories of fossil specimens, are finding it difficult to compete with the deep pockets of private collectors, who are often willing to pay top dollar for rare and valuable fossils. This has led to concerns that many scientifically significant specimens are being lost to private collections, where they may not be properly conserved or made available for research. As a result, scientists and museum curators are warning that the pursuit of scientific knowledge is being compromised by the growing commercialization of the fossil trade.

According to officials at Sotheby's, the T. rex skeleton sold at auction for a record-breaking price, exceeding expectations and highlighting the growing demand for fossils among private collectors. The skeleton, which is estimated to be around 67 million years old, is considered one of the most complete and well-preserved T. rex specimens ever found, making it a highly prized acquisition for any museum or collector. However, many scientists and museum curators have expressed disappointment that the specimen was not acquired by a museum, where it could have been made available for research and public display. Instead, the skeleton will be held in a private collection, where its accessibility for scientific study is uncertain.

The sale of the T. rex skeleton has sparked a lively debate among scientists, museum curators, and private collectors about the ethics of fossil collecting and the impact of commercialization on the pursuit of scientific knowledge. Many scientists and museum curators argue that fossils are an important part of our cultural and scientific heritage, and that they should be preserved and made available for research and public display. Private collectors, on the other hand, argue that they are preserving important specimens and making them available for study, even if they are not always accessible to the general public. As the debate continues, many are calling for greater regulation of the fossil trade to ensure that scientifically significant specimens are preserved for the benefit of science and society.

The growing trend of private buyers outbidding museums for fossils has significant implications for the scientific community and the general public. Many museums, which rely on fossil specimens to educate and inform the public about the natural world, are finding it difficult to acquire new specimens, which can limit their ability to develop new exhibits and educational programs. Furthermore, the loss of scientifically significant specimens to private collections can hinder the pursuit of scientific knowledge, as researchers may not have access to important specimens for study. As a result, many are calling for greater collaboration between museums, scientists, and private collectors to ensure that fossils are preserved and made available for research and public display.

As the debate over the ethics of fossil collecting continues, many are watching to see how the scientific community and governments will respond to the growing trend of private buyers outbidding museums for fossils. Some are calling for greater regulation of the fossil trade, including laws and regulations that would require private collectors to make their specimens available for scientific study and public display. Others are advocating for greater collaboration between museums, scientists, and private collectors to ensure that fossils are preserved and made available for research and public display. As the issue continues to unfold, one thing is clear: the pursuit of scientific knowledge and the preservation of our cultural and scientific heritage are at stake, and it will require a concerted effort from all stakeholders to ensure that fossils are preserved for the benefit of science and society.

items.teaser: Indians working in the United Kingdom prior to July 15, 2026, will not be eligible for the India-U.K. Dispute Settlement Mechanism and Co…
items.story:
Indians working in the United Kingdom prior to July 15, 2026, will not be eligible for the India-U.K. Dispute Settlement Mechanism and Cooperation Committee, according to recent clarifications. This development affects thousands of Indian nationals who have been residing and working in the U.K. for various periods. The India-U.K. Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement, which came into effect on July 15, 2026, aims to strengthen economic ties between the two nations. The agreement's provisions have been closely watched by businesses, policymakers, and individuals on both sides.

The India-U.K. Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement marks a significant milestone in the bilateral relationship between the two countries, building on a long history of trade and cultural exchange. The agreement is expected to increase trade volumes, promote investment, and create new opportunities for businesses and individuals alike. The dispute settlement mechanism is a key component of the agreement, providing a framework for resolving trade-related disputes and promoting cooperation between the two nations. The clarification regarding the applicability of the mechanism to Indian workers in the U.K. prior to July 15, 2026, is crucial for understanding the agreement's implications.

According to official statements, the dispute settlement mechanism is designed to provide a fair and transparent process for resolving trade-related disputes, with a focus on cooperation and mutual understanding. The mechanism will be overseen by a joint committee comprising representatives from both countries, who will work together to resolve disputes and promote trade facilitation. Indian officials have emphasized that the agreement will benefit Indian businesses and workers, while U.K. officials have highlighted the potential for increased trade and investment. The exact number of Indian workers affected by the clarification is not yet known, but estimates suggest that thousands of individuals may be impacted.

The clarification has sparked mixed reactions from stakeholders, with some expressing concerns about the potential impact on Indian workers in the U.K. who may not be eligible for the dispute settlement mechanism. Others have welcomed the agreement, citing its potential to promote trade and investment between the two nations. Indian business leaders have urged the government to provide more information about the agreement's provisions and how they will be implemented. Meanwhile, U.K. officials have emphasized the importance of the agreement in promoting economic cooperation and trade facilitation.

The India-U.K. Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement has significant implications for the regional and global economy, as it marks a major step forward in bilateral trade relations between the two nations. The agreement is expected to have a positive impact on trade volumes, with estimates suggesting that bilateral trade could increase significantly in the coming years. The agreement may also have implications for other countries in the region, as it sets a precedent for future trade agreements and cooperation mechanisms. As the agreement is implemented, policymakers and businesses will be watching closely to see how it affects trade flows and economic cooperation between India and the U.K.

As the India-U.K. Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement begins to take shape, several key questions remain unanswered, including how the dispute settlement mechanism will be implemented in practice and what support will be provided to Indian workers in the U.K. who are not eligible for the mechanism. Officials from both countries are expected to meet in the coming weeks to discuss the agreement's implementation and address any concerns or questions that may arise. Meanwhile, businesses and individuals are eagerly awaiting more information about the agreement's provisions and how they will be affected by the new trade regime.

items.story: U.S. electricity consumption set a new record high last year and is on track for new all-time highs this year and next, as the AI boom has ended America’s decade of stagnant power use. items.story: പുരവഞ്ചിയിൽനിന്ന് വീണ് തമിഴ്നാട് സ്വദേശിനി മരിച്ചു; ജീവൻ നഷ്ടമായത് ആലപ്പുഴയിലെ സ്പാ ജീവനക്കാരിക്ക് Mathrubhumiആലപ്പുഴയിൽ ഹൗസ്‌ബോട്ടിൽ നിന്ന് കായലിൽ വീണ സ്പാ ജീവനക്കാരി മരിച്ചു News18 Malayalamഹൗസ്‌ ബോട്ടിൽ ഉല്ലാസ യാത്രയ്ക്കിടെ യുവതി കായലിൽ വീണു മരിച്ചു; അപകടം അർധരാത്രി Manorama Onlineസ്പാ ജീവനക്കാരി ഹൗസ്ബോട്ടിൽ നിന്ന് കായലിൽ വീണ് മരിച്ചു; കൂടെയുണ്ടായിരുന്ന 5 പേർ കസ്റ്റഡിയിൽ manoramanews.comആലപ്പുഴ പുന്നമടയില്‍ ഹൗസ്‌ബോട്ടില്‍ നിന്ന് കായലിലേക്ക് വീണ് യുവതി മരിച്ചു Thejas News

items.story: കേരളത്തിൽ കപ്പൽ നിർമാണം; 10,000 കോടി രൂപ നിക്ഷേപിക്കാനൊരുങ്ങി ടാറ്റ Manorama Onlineകേരളത്തിൽ കപ്പൽ നിർമ്മാണത്തിന് ടാറ്റ ഗ്രൂപ്പ്; 10000 കോടിയുടെ നിക്ഷേപം വരുന്നു Mathrubhumiകേരളത്തിൽ കപ്പൽ നി‌ർമ്മാണ ശാലയുമായി ടാറ്റ ഗ്രൂപ്പ്,​ വരുന്നത് 10000 കോടി രൂപയുടെ നിക്ഷേപം Kerala Kaumudiസംസ്ഥാനത്ത് 10000 കോടിയുടെ വമ്പന്‍ നിക്ഷേപത്തിന് ടാറ്റ! വെളിപ്പെടുത്തി മുഖ്യമന്ത്രി സതീശൻ, കേരളത്തിൽ കപ്പൽ നിർമാണ ശാല Asianet News Malayalamകേരളത്തിൽ കപ്പൽ നിർമാണത്തിന് പതിനായിരം കോടിയുടെ നിക്ഷേപവുമായി ടാറ്റ Deepika.com

In these materials, light-generated excitons can interact directly with magnetic behavior, creating opportunities to control magnetic states using light alone. Scientists believe this could pave the way for advanced optical memory, quantum devices, and ultra-efficient photonic technologies.

items.story: When the Marshall Fire tore through suburban Colorado in late 2021, residents had only hours to decide where to go. Some fled to nearby towns. items.headline: Common constipation drug may help clear depression brain fog
items.teaser: An existing constipation drug may have an unexpected new use: helping clear the "brain fog" that often lingers after depression. In a sma…
items.story: An existing constipation drug may have an unexpected new use: helping clear the "brain fog" that often lingers after depression. In a small clinical trial, people with a history of depression who took the medication prucalopride for about a week performed better on tests of memory, attention, and thinking speed than those who received a placebo. The drug targets a serotonin receptor found in both the gut and the brain, and researchers saw no significant side effects.
